description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {1}, causing it to gain all activated abilities of Surge Engine until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Surge Engine's third ability by paying {6}, causing you to draw three cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {5}.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.
